en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing the interior of a traditional wine tavern or restaurant. The room has neatly set tables with white tablecloths, wooden chairs, framed pictures and plates on the walls, a hanging guitar, and decorative objects such as vases and a bust. Below the photograph there is a rhyming German text inviting visitors to rest and drink wine, and at the bottom it names the place as a wine bar called "Weinstuben zum Kellermeister" in Meissen.
